This means creators can get paid instantly and efficiently, without relying on restricted platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy this infrastructure, you will need to have a GitHub account, a Cloudflare account, and a NOWPayments account. You will also need to have a basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Additionally, you will need to have a payment method that supports cryptocurrency, such as a Binance P2P account that supports Kenyan shillings. With these tools and knowledge, you can deploy a sovereign payment infrastructure that enables you to get paid internationally.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will need to integrate NOWPayments with your GitHub Pages site and Cloudflare Workers. This will allow you to automatically verify on-chain crypto payments and deliver digital products to your customers. You will also need to configure your Cloudflare account to support payment processing and delivery. With this setup, you can ensure that payments are processed efficiently and securely, and that digital products are delivered to customers on time.

Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running
